newsitem.title: CHINA: China mulls review of foreign equity in chemicals.
newsitem.headline: China mulls review of foreign equity in chemicals.

text.p: China may study changes in its policies toward foreign joint venture investment in the chemicals sector, Minister of Chemical Industry Gu Xiulian said on Friday.

She did not say what specific changes might be considered or when the review might be made. But she said the ministry currently allowed foreign companies to control joint ventures when new technology was introduced to the China market.
"We will study the question of controlling interest in joint ventures," she told a news conference, without giving further details.
She said China continued to welcome foreign capital in the chemical industry, and it hoped to have cumulative foreign investment of $12 billion in the sector by the year 2000.
Beijing's aim in the coming years would be technology transfer rather than earning foreign exchange.
Beijing also hoped to promote foreign investment in central and western regions, which have lagged behind eastern coastal areas, she said.
